ideas.pitch: A forecasting tool tailored for campus energy consumption and local microgrid resilience using Poisson regression and historical weather models.
ideas.title: CampusGrid RPI: AI Microgrid Load Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact success pattern of predicting complex systems with calibrated confidence intervals and appeals directly to institutional infrastructure themes.

ideas.pitch: An investigative dashboard mapping off-campus housing scams, suspicious landlord transactions, and anomalous rental listings using graph intelligence.
ideas.title: TroyRentGuard: Student Housing Scam & AML Graph Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem every college student and local resident in Troy, New York feels deeply every leasing season.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered meal recommendation and nutritional tracking platform that optimizes local dining hall menus and redirects surplus food to campus food banks.
ideas.title: RPI Dining AI Nutritionist & Surplus Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines personal health utility with a clear, quantified campus-wide social impact metric.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent-powered ride-pooling and micro-transit coordinator connecting RPI students with elderly residents in Troy for grocery runs and medical appointments.
ideas.title: CapitalRegion ShuttleSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets regional community needs with a tangible social good angle that resonates strongly with local hackathon judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite imagery monitoring tool tracking industrial land changes and environmental runoff along the Hudson River near Troy.
ideas.title: HudsonRiver EcoSat: Industrial Runoff Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses hard environmental data visualization and satellite APIs to demonstrate measurable ecological oversight.
